اصطخبت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَخَبْتُ (iṣṭaḵabtu) /isˤ.tˤa.xab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# اِصْطَخَبْتَ (iṣṭaḵabta) /isˤ.tˤa.xab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# اِصْطَخَبْتِ (iṣṭaḵabti) /isˤ.tˤa.xab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# اِصْطَخَبَتْ (iṣṭaḵabat) /isˤ.tˤa.xa.bat/: thi
